content.short: Momentum is a comprehensive DeFi hub on Sui featuring a CLMM DEX, liquid staking, and sophisticated ve(3,3) tokenomics.
content.description: Momentum is an all-in-one decentralized finance hub and liquidity engine built natively on the Sui blockchain. Formerly known as MSafe, the platform features a highly efficient Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker (CLMM) exchange, providing users with professional-grade trading tools and minimal slippage. Momentum utilizes a sophisticated ve(3,3) tokenomics model, where users can lock MMT tokens for veMMT to participate in governance and receive 100% of protocol-generated fees. Beyond its core exchange features, Momentum offers liquid staking through xSUI, allowing participants to earn network staking rewards while maintaining capital liquidity for use on-chain.
content.meta: Momentum provides a CLMM DEX, liquid staking, and ve(3,3) governance for the Sui blockchain ecosystem. Discover Momentum on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
